description:
Investigate the Emoncms system to discover all existing feeds and their current status. Create a JSON report saved to '/home/ga/emoncms_status_report.json' with the following structure:

{
  "report_title": "Emoncms System Status Report",
  "total_feeds": <integer>,
  "feeds": [
    {
      "id": <integer>,
      "name": "<string>",
      "tag": "<string>",
      "value": <number or null>,
      "unit": "<string>",
      "engine": <integer>
    },
    ...
  ]
}

The 'feeds' array must contain ALL feeds present in the system. The 'total_feeds' must equal the number of feeds in the array. Values should be the latest available readings.
